evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/gui/E directly extends JPanel, installs BorderLayout, uses Launcher.j as size/minimum/preferred size and has a black background; it owns no unrelated controls or state.
Launcher constructs exactly one rs/gui/E during UI startup, sizes it to the game client dimensions and retains it as launcher field n.
After Client.init() and Client.start(), Launcher adds the live Client component to rs/gui/E at BorderLayout.CENTER, making this panel the concrete Swing host for the game client surface.
Launcher then adds rs/gui/E into the main launcher content panel before packing/showing the frame; no other exact-v308 class owns or constructs this panel.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the dedicated Swing panel that hosts the live Client component inside Launcher. No original stripped identifier is claimed.
